sentence: Let me start by asking you a question: what's the first thing you notice about a film?
translation: 让我从一个问题开始：对于一部电影，你首先注意到的是什么？
analysis: 演讲开场经典句式：Let me start by doing sth（by 表方式，接动名词），先设问再展开，瞬间抓住听众 | 冒号后直接抛出疑问句，口语化互动 | the first thing you notice about a film：课件专门指出这是省略关系代词 that 的限定性定语从句（that 作 notice 的宾语可省）——the first thing (that) you notice；序数词/最高级作先行词时关系词只能用 that | notice about 搭配：注意到（某物的）某个方面
pattern: Let me start by + V-ing: 疑问句?
imitationCn: 让我从一个小实验开始：你早上醒来后拿起的第一样东西是什么？
imitationHint: Let me start by doing a small experiment: what's the first thing (that) you pick up after waking up?（省略 that 的定语从句）
imitationAnswer: Let me start by doing a small experiment: what's the first thing you pick up after waking up in the morning?

sentence: Whatever your answer is, there's always a lot more to it than first meets the eye.
translation: 无论你的答案是什么，电影都远比你最初表面看到的更为复杂。
analysis: Whatever your answer is = No matter what your answer is：whatever 引导让步状语从句（课件辨析：whatever 引导名词性从句时 = anything that，不能换 no matter what）| 主句是习语级句型：there is more to sth than meets the eye 某事物比表面看到的更复杂/更有内涵——meets the eye 中 meet the eye 意为“映入眼帘”，than 后省略主语 what | a lot 修饰比较级 more，first 修饰 meets（最初看到）| 此句型可整体迁移进读后续写和议论文：There is more to that problem than meets the eye.
pattern: Whatever + S + be, there's (a lot) more to + sth + than (first) meets the eye
imitationCn: 无论这份工作看起来多么简单，它都远比表面看到的更有讲究。
imitationHint: However simple the job may look（换用 however+adj. 的让步）→ there's a lot more to it than first meets the eye
imitationAnswer: However simple the job may look, there's a lot more to it than first meets the eye.

sentence: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes.
translation: 事实上，你在银幕上看到的电影是大量艰苦工作的成果，其中大部分是在幕后进行的。
analysis: 双从句嵌套 | the film (that) you see on the screen：省略 that 的定语从句作主语的修饰 | 句末 most of which takes place behind the scenes：“数量词 + of which/whom”型非限定性定语从句——which 指代 hard work，most of which = and most of it；同族结构：some of which / both of whom / the largest of which，写作加分句型 | 谓语 takes 单数与 most (of the work) 呼应 | behind the scenes 在幕后（本文标题意象；引申义“不为人知地”）| Actually 句首副词，引出“真相”与读者预期形成反差
pattern: S + (that省略)定语从句 + is the product of + N, most of which + V ...
imitationCn: 你台上看到的十分钟表演是数月排练的成果，其中大部分观众从未见过。
imitationHint: The ten-minute performance you see on stage is the product of months of rehearsal → , most of which the audience never sees（数量词+of which）
imitationAnswer: The ten-minute performance you see on stage is the product of months of rehearsal, most of which the audience never sees.

sentence: These are often added after a scene has been shot and might not be made in the way you would expect.
translation: 这些（音效）通常是在场景拍摄完成后添加的，而且可能不是按照你期望的方式制作的。
analysis: 全句贯穿被动语态：are added / has been shot / be made——说明制作流程时“事被做”比“谁在做”重要，说明文语态选择的示范 | after 从句用现在完成时 has been shot，强调“拍完之后”的先后顺序 | shoot 多义词（课件专项）：拍摄（本句）/ 射击 / 投篮进球 / 快速移动（Ward's hand shot out）| in the way (that/in which) you would expect：the way 作先行词，关系词可用 that/in which 或省略；would expect 委婉虚拟“按你原本会以为的方式” | might not 表可能性的否定：“可能并不……”
pattern: S + be + V-ed + after + S + has been + V-ed + and might not be + V-ed + in the way (that) + S + would expect
imitationCn: 这些照片通常是在活动结束后精修的，而且可能不是以你以为的方式处理的。
imitationHint: These photos are often edited after the event has ended → and might not be processed in the way you would expect
imitationAnswer: These photos are often edited after the event has ended, and might not be processed in the way you would expect.

sentence: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects.
translation: 另一个我非常重视的方面是视觉特效。
analysis: 主语 Another aspect 带省略 that 的定语从句 I attach great importance to——注意介词 to 悬空在从句末尾（attach importance to 的 to 不可丢），完整形式 = another aspect to which I attach great importance | attach great importance/significance to 高度重视（课堂重点搭配；attach 本义“系上、附上”：attach a label to sth 贴标签、attach a photo to the form 贴照片）| 主系表结构把最重要的信息（visual special effects）放句末压轴——英语“尾重原则”的信息编排 | 此句型是写作亮点句：What I attach great importance to is...
pattern: Another aspect (that) + S + attach importance to + is + N
imitationCn: 另一个我非常重视的品质是团队精神。
imitationHint: Another quality I attach great importance to → is team spirit（介词 to 留在从句句尾）
imitationAnswer: Another quality I attach great importance to is team spirit.

sentence: It took 500 workers 100 days to build the fine model, not to mention the thousands of props inside.
translation: 500 名工人花了 100 天才造好这个精美的模型，更不用说里面的数千件道具了。
analysis: It takes sb + 时间 + to do sth 经典句型：耗时表达，it 为形式主语 | 双数字对举（500 workers / 100 days）用数据制造冲击力——说明文量化论证 | not to mention 更不用说（= let alone / much less），引出更进一层的信息，起强调作用；课堂 mention 短语群：don't mention it 不客气、make no mention of 只字不提、at the mention of 一提到 | the thousands of props inside：inside 副词作后置定语
pattern: It took + sb + 时间 + to V ..., not to mention + N
imitationCn: 十位志愿者花了整整两周才整理好这批图书，更不用说上千张借阅卡片了。
imitationHint: It took ten volunteers two whole weeks to sort out the books → , not to mention the thousands of library cards
imitationAnswer: It took ten volunteers two whole weeks to sort out the books, not to mention the thousands of library cards.

sentence: My lecture today may not be able to do justice to all the work people have done behind the scenes.
translation: 我今天的讲座，可能无法对人们在幕后所做的全部工作给予公正的展现。
analysis: do justice to sb/sth 高级习语：公正对待、充分展现……的价值（“配得上”）——演讲收尾的谦辞，暗含“幕后工作远比我讲的多” | all the work (that) people have done：省略 that 的定语从句，从句用现在完成时（迄今为止做过的）| may not be able to 三重弱化（可能+否定+能力），语气克制得体 | behind the scenes 再次点题，与开头 the product of hard work 首尾呼应——演讲结构的闭环技巧 | 课堂 justice 拓展：a sense of justice 正义感、bring sb to justice 绳之以法、promote social justice
pattern: S + may not be able to do justice to + all the N (that) + S + have + V-ed
imitationCn: 这篇短文可能无法充分展现志愿者们付出的全部心血。
imitationHint: This short article may not be able to do justice to → all the effort (that) the volunteers have put in
imitationAnswer: This short article may not be able to do justice to all the effort the volunteers have put in.

sentence: However, the film's director, Ang Lee, preferred to have actors perform on location.
translation: 然而，这部电影的导演李安更愿意让演员在实地表演。
analysis: the film's director, Ang Lee：同位语插入（职务在前、人名在后，逗号隔开），新闻与影评介绍人物的标准写法 | prefer to do 更愿意做（课堂 prefer 全家桶：prefer A to B、prefer doing A to doing B、prefer to do A rather than do B、would prefer that + 虚拟）| have actors perform：使役 have + 宾语 + 省 to 不定式（= 安排/让某人做），辨析 have sb doing 让某人持续做、have sth done 让某事被做 | on location 影视术语“实地拍摄”（区别于摄影棚 studio）——与上文 CGI 特效形成“实景派 vs 特效派”的对比论证
pattern: S 同位语, + preferred to have + sb + V（省to不定式）
imitationCn: 然而，这个项目的负责人王教授更愿意让学生自己设计实验。
imitationHint: the project's leader, Professor Wang（同位语）→ preferred to have students design the experiments themselves（have sb do）
imitationAnswer: However, the project's leader, Professor Wang, preferred to have students design the experiments themselves.

sentence: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
translation: 除了精彩的武术之外，这部电影还充分利用了中国美丽的山脉、森林和沙漠。
analysis: In addition to + 名词：介词短语“除……之外（还有）”（= besides），课堂辨析：in addition 是副词性的“此外”，后不接宾语——两者填空高频互辨 | take advantage of 利用（中性/积极义；贬义时=“占便宜”）| mountains, forests and deserts 三项并列收尾，具体地貌铺陈画面感——写景列举的节奏（两逗一and）| also 与 in addition to 配合，双重叠加“还”的递进
pattern: In addition to + N, S + also + took advantage of + N₁, N₂ and N₃
imitationCn: 除了地道的美食之外，这座城市还充分利用了它的古街、老桥和运河。
imitationHint: In addition to the authentic food, the city also took advantage of → its old streets, ancient bridges and canals（三并列）
imitationAnswer: In addition to the authentic food, the city also took advantage of its old streets, ancient bridges and canals.

sentence: Despite an IQ of 75, he lives a truly amazing life.
translation: 尽管智商只有 75，他却过着真正令人惊叹的生活。
analysis: Despite + 名词短语：介词表让步（= in spite of），课堂核心辨析：despite 后只接名词/动名词/the fact that 从句，不可直接接从句（接从句用 although/though）——语法填空高频考点 | an IQ of 75：of + 数字表属性（an IQ of 75 / a height of 2 metres）| live a... life 同源宾语结构：live a happy/amazing/simple life | truly amazing 副词强化 | 短句大反差：低智商 vs 惊叹人生，一句话立起阿甘的人物弧——人物简介的高效写法
pattern: Despite + a(n) + N + of + 数字, S + lives a + adj. + life
imitationCn: 尽管年过七十，她仍然过着非常充实的生活。
imitationHint: Despite an age of over seventy（或 Despite being over seventy）→ she still lives a truly full life
imitationAnswer: Despite an age of over seventy, she still lives a truly full life.

sentence: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century.
translation: 他目睹了、有时甚至影响了 20 世纪下半叶美国的一些重大事件。
analysis: 插入式并列谓语：sees, and sometimes influences, 两个动词共享同一个宾语，第二个谓语用逗号包夹插入——制造“先目睹、进而卷入”的递进惊喜，比平铺 sees and influences 更有节奏 | some of the major events of...：多层 of 短语精确限定（一些/重大/美国的/下半叶的）| in the second half of the 20th century 时间状语（the first/second half of + 时间段）| 剧本简介用一般现在时叙述（历史现在时），使故事“正在上演”
pattern: S + V₁, and sometimes + V₂, + 共享宾语
imitationCn: 她记录了、有时也改变了这座小城过去三十年的许多重要时刻。
imitationHint: She records, and sometimes changes, → many of the important moments of the small town over the past three decades（第二个谓语逗号插入）
imitationAnswer: She records, and sometimes changes, many of the important moments of the small town over the past three decades.

sentence: I don't recall what I got for my first Christmas and I don't know when I went on my first outdoor picnic.
translation: 我不记得第一个圣诞节收到了什么，也不知道第一次户外野餐是什么时候。
analysis: 两个否定句并列，各带一个疑问词宾语从句：what I got（what 作 got 的宾语）/ when I went（when 作状语）——宾语从句一律用陈述语序，don't recall what I got 不能说成 what did I get | recall 不接不定式作宾语：recall (doing) sth / recall + 从句（课堂拓展：I don't recall seeing any cars.）| 电影台词的口语并列（and 连接两个完整分句），朴素的重复节奏正是阿甘的语言人设——“不记得什么，也不知道什么，但我记得妈妈的话”的铺垫 | for Christmas 节日收礼用 for、go on a picnic 固定搭配
pattern: S + don't recall + what-从句 + and + S + don't know + when-从句
imitationCn: 我不记得自己第一次骑车摔了多少跤，也不知道最后是怎么突然学会的。
imitationHint: I don't recall how many times I fell off... → and I don't know how I suddenly learned...（两个疑问词从句都用陈述语序）
imitationAnswer: I don't recall how many times I fell off my first bike, and I don't know how I suddenly learned to ride it in the end.

sentence: In the meantime, Hooper skilfully creates uncertainty and tension with narrow indoor sets and dark lighting.
translation: 与此同时，胡珀巧妙地用狭窄的室内布景和昏暗的灯光营造出不确定感和紧张感。
analysis: 影评“技法分析句”的范本：导演（主语）+ 手法副词（skilfully）+ 效果（uncertainty and tension）+ with 手段（sets and lighting）——评价影视作品的万能框架 | with + 名词短语作方式状语：“借助/用……”，比 by using 更凝练 | 抽象名词并列 uncertainty and tension（观感效果）对应具体名词并列 narrow indoor sets and dark lighting（物理手段），抽象/具体两组并列彼此映照 | narrow 课堂拓展：a narrow escape 九死一生、a narrow victory 险胜、narrow down 缩小范围 | In the meantime 与此同时（衔接上文另一条线索）
pattern: S + adv. + creates + 抽象N₁ and 抽象N₂ + with + 具体N₁ and 具体N₂
imitationCn: 与此同时，作者巧妙地用短句和重复营造出紧迫感和压抑感。
imitationHint: In the meantime, the writer skilfully creates urgency and heaviness → with short sentences and repetition（with 表手段）
imitationAnswer: In the meantime, the writer skilfully creates urgency and heaviness with short sentences and repetition.

sentence: All in all, I highly recommend this film.
translation: 总而言之，我强烈推荐这部电影。
analysis: 影评/书评收尾的标志句式：All in all（总而言之，= in conclusion/on the whole）+ 明确表态 | highly recommend 高频搭配：“强烈推荐”（highly 修饰 recommend/praise/value 等评价类动词，比 very much 地道）| recommend 课堂语法卡：recommend doing 建议做 / recommend sb to do 建议某人做 / recommend that sb (should) do——从句用 (should)+动词原形的虚拟语气，与 suggest/advise/insist 同族，语法填空高频 | 短句收尾干脆有力——长分析后用最短的句子亮出结论，节奏对比即说服力
pattern: All in all, S + highly recommend + N
imitationCn: 总而言之，我强烈建议每位新生都读一读这本手册。
imitationHint: All in all, I highly recommend that every new student (should) read this handbook（recommend that 后用虚拟）
imitationAnswer: All in all, I highly recommend that every new student read this handbook.
